_note: MODULE TIER (#567). The console provides no service, and no service owns its one field of its own: the console's backend reads it (tappaas-cicd/ui/src/litellm.ts), so it is a general field of this module.

assistantModel.description: The LiteLLM model the console's assistant asks for (ADR-034 D7, O3). Absent: LiteLLM's model named `default` when the console's key may use one, else the first model LiteLLM lists for the key.
